claims.population: The article gives a population of 392,854 at the 2006 census.
claims.climate: Yola has a tropical savanna climate bordering on hot semi-arid; it receives about 872 mm of rain a year, with a wet season from May to October and a dry season for the rest of the year.
claims.history: Yola was founded in 1841 by Modibbo Adama, and the old town is where the Lamido of Adamawa resides, while Jimeta is the administrative and commercial centre.
